n01-open
Every architecture conversation ends with the same two questions. <break time='200ms'/> What will it cost? <break time='150ms'/> And where should it run?
n02-title
In this episode: pricing a design, sizing it for production, and comparing regions.
n03-draft
Here's the clinic booking draft again. The total in the toolbar is the monthly run rate, at Azure retail prices for the selected region.
n04-badges
Every service carries its own price badge, so you see at a glance where the money goes. <break time='120ms'/> Here, the App Service plan is more than half the bill.
n05-regions
Change the region, and the whole design reprices. Fourteen regions, from Virginia to Sydney, each priced from its own catalog snapshot.
n06-canada
Customer in Toronto? Canada Central comes in just under East US 2.
n07-brazil
São Paulo runs about a fifth more for the exact same design. <break time='120ms'/> Better to know that before the proposal, not after.
n08-tier
Now size it for production. Click any price badge to change the tier and the instance count: <break time='100ms'/> Premium v3, two instances.
n09-tier-cost
You see the new figure before you apply it, and the total follows. Have a negotiated price? Override the estimate with your own.
n10-yours
And the layout is yours, too. Drag anything to where it reads best.
n11-export
When it's time to share the numbers, export the costs. One click gives you a spreadsheet, JSON, and a full Cost Intelligence report.
n12-report
Top cost drivers. Flags worth a second look. <break time='120ms'/> And all fourteen regions ranked for this exact design, so you know where you stand, and what a move would save.
n13-hide
Showing the design to a customer with their own pricing? One click hides every estimate on the canvas.
n14-close
Price it, size it, place it. <break time='150ms'/> Before anyone has to ask.
